semantic.justification: Direct TypeScript port of the pinned md4c 0.5.3 UTF-8 block, mark-resolution and callback pipeline. Preserves source byte offsets, callback chunk boundaries and attributes, source flag defaults, reference budgets, container state and callback abort codes. All 813 complete callback streams match compiled unmodified md_parse, including 733 bundled CommonMark/extension cases. Native allocation failures, C pointer ABI and unused/uninitialized fields are not emulated. Writer callback integration remains pending; these dependency fixtures do not establish complete Writer import parity. B8TCAE adds14 minimized public UTF8 input/flag cases to the existing native-edge callback corpus: unclosed/escaped link destinations and labels, terminal angle prefixes, table delimiter/header boundaries, collapsed spaces, unmatched strikethrough/math delimiters and terminal WWW slashes. All complete initialized callback streams are regenerated by the unchanged pinned md4c0.5.3 source after exact archive/member verification. Existing full callback and block-consumer suites replay the same cases. Diagnostic selection only read per-call Istanbul deltas; temporary diagnostics were removed and no source state, coverage counter, exclusion or threshold was changed. Current6 suites1848 tests pass; exact-map before/after comparison closes11 statements and19 branch arms. Remaining full100 coverage and ABI/resource-failure claims are not certified. B8TCAE adds6 structured public-input native cases for inline multiline titles in double/single/parenthesis quote forms, multiline image titles, and the63/64-byte email-domain label boundary. Complete callback streams are independently regenerated and checked against unchanged original md4c0.5.3. Current6 suites1860 tests pass; exact-map comparison adds3 statements and2 branch arms, including the admitted multiline-title pointer stack and normal-block temporary cleanup. Callback values and source-path execution are verified, not native allocation/free ABI or fault behavior. Runtime source, counters, discovery and thresholds remain unchanged. B8TCAE producer audit:  M12a/M12b exclude only absent list/quote replay slots, because analysis preserves dense container storage up to its peak and the balanced queue cannot exceed it. M13 excludes only the leading blank-code trim advance: blank classification precedes new indented-code creation, continuation blanks require an existing code block, and fences use data1. The loop/guards remain; exact token/map proof excludes one zero-hit statement/two alternatives and retains all other counters/functions. The complete8-suite/2017-test parser run passes all assertions; six-owner statements/lines/functions are100%, while two unresolved alternatives keep the combined branch gate failing. Runtime algorithms, original C source, input discovery and100% thresholds remain unchanged; full callback-detail/Writer model/ABI equivalence is not claimed.
